bullets: [1] δ value should be same for Long sequence and short sequence
(same positions will be encoded with same values irrespective of the length of the sequence)
[2] Range of position encoded values should NOT depend on sequence length
(predefined fixed range  e.g. from 0 to 1 , form -1 to 1 , ...)
[3] Position Encoding  should be a  VECTOR (not scalar) and of same dimension as Word Embedding
(in order to easily  combine Position Encoding and Word Encoding vectors)

visual_elements.description: Row 1: a long dashed rounded-rectangle container (dark-gray dashed outline, no fill) holding 8 small rectangles with solid red borders and very light pink fill, labeled in red italic serif: Word 0, Word 1, Word 2, Word 3, Word 4, Word 5, Word N-2, Word N-1 (the 'N-2'/'N-1' set slightly low, subscript-like). Between Word 5 and Word N-2 sit 5 small solid gray dots indicating omitted middle words. To the left, outside the container, the gray italic three-line label 'Sequence of words with Length N'.

Row 2: identical structure to Row 1 but blue-themed: dashed blue rounded container holding 8 rectangles with solid blue borders and light periwinkle-blue fill, labeled in blue italic serif: Pos 0, Pos 1, Pos 2, Pos 3, Pos 4, Pos 5, Pos N-2, Pos N-1 (subscript-style N-2/N-1). Between Pos 5 and Pos N-2 sit 5 small solid steel-blue dots. Left label in blue bold: 'Position Embedding' (two lines).

Row 3: dashed muted-red rounded container holding 8 white rectangles with solid red borders, labeled in red italic serif: 0, δ, 2δ, 3δ, 4δ, 5δ, 1-δ, 1. There is a wide empty gap (no dots) between the 5δ box and the 1-δ box. Beneath the boxes, 6 short orange curved arrows point rightward connecting consecutive boxes: 0→δ, δ→2δ, 2δ→3δ, 3δ→4δ, 4δ→5δ, and 1-δ→1; each arrow carries the orange bold label '+δ' underneath. Left label in red bold: 'Use Position Index' (two lines).

Large rounded rectangle, pale-yellow fill, medium blue border, containing three numbered rules in blue sans-serif text. Rule [1]: 'δ value should be same for Long sequence and short sequence' ('δ value should be same' bold) with sub-line '(same positions will be encoded with same values irrespective of the length of the sequence)' ('same positions' underlined). Rule [2]: 'Range of position encoded values should NOT depend on sequence length' (both halves bold) with sub-line '(predefined fixed range  e.g. from 0 to 1 , form -1 to 1 , ...)'. Rule [3]: 'Position Encoding  should be a  VECTOR (not scalar) and of same dimension as Word Embedding' ('Position Encoding should be a VECTOR' bold; 'same dimension' bold+underlined; 'Word Embedding' appears underlined [?]) with sub-line '(in order to easily  combine Position Encoding and Word Encoding vectors)'.
Slide-number badge: small circle filled yellow with a thin dark outline, containing the number '24' in dark bold text.
Six small curved orange arrows with arrowheads pointing right, one under each adjacent pair of position-index boxes, each labeled '+δ' in orange bold sans-serif.
